es.name: Selección de jets de alto pT
es.physical_meaning: Exige un evento multijet suficientemente energético. Las ramas por rango se combinan con OR; si un jet no existe, solo esa rama es falsa.
es.analysis_rationale: Es la rama de evento de la región High-pT que selecciona producción hadrónica energética.

cuts.name: High-pT jet selection
cuts.mathematical_definition: (Njet≥4 ∧ pT(j4)>250 GeV) ∨ (Njet≥5 ∧ pT(j5)>195 GeV) ∨ (Njet≥6 ∧ pT(j6)>116 GeV) ∨ (Njet≥7 ∧ pT(j7)>90 GeV)
cuts.physical_meaning: Requires a sufficiently energetic multijet event. Each jet-rank branch is an OR; a missing jet makes only that branch false.
cuts.analysis_rationale: This is the High-pT signal-region event leg used to select energetic hadronic production.

es.name: Vértice desplazado fiducial
es.physical_meaning: Al menos un decaimiento LLP ocurre dentro del volumen fiducial de verdad usado para el DV.
es.analysis_rationale: Restringe los vértices a la región radial y longitudinal modelada por el recast.

cuts.name: Fiducial displaced vertex
cuts.mathematical_definition: ∃ LLP decay vertex: R_DV < 300 mm ∧ |z_DV| < 300 mm
cuts.physical_meaning: At least one LLP decay lies inside the truth-level DV fiducial volume.
cuts.analysis_rationale: Restricts vertices to the radial and longitudinal region modeled by the recast.

es.name: Radio del DV mayor que 4 mm
es.physical_meaning: Selecciona un vértice claramente desplazado respecto de la línea del haz.
es.analysis_rationale: Suprime vértices prompt y entra en el dominio del mapa de respuesta del DV.

cuts.name: DV radius above 4 mm
cuts.physical_meaning: Selects a vertex measurably displaced from the beam line.
cuts.analysis_rationale: Suppresses prompt vertices and enters the domain of the DV response map.

es.name: Al menos una traza desplazada
es.physical_meaning: Exige que al menos una hija cargada no apunte de regreso a la línea del haz.
es.analysis_rationale: Rechaza vértices sin una firma de traza cargada desplazada.

cuts.name: At least one displaced track
cuts.physical_meaning: Requires evidence that at least one charged daughter does not point back to the beam line.
cuts.analysis_rationale: Rejects vertices without a displaced charged-track signature.

es.name: Al menos cinco trazas seleccionadas
es.physical_meaning: Conserva vértices multitraza con suficiente actividad cargada reconstruible.
es.analysis_rationale: Reduce fondos de baja multiplicidad y define un eje del mapa de respuesta del vértice.

cuts.name: At least five selected tracks
cuts.mathematical_definition: N(selected charged final daughters) ≥ 5, with βγτ > 520 mm and pT/|q| > 1 GeV
cuts.physical_meaning: Keeps multi-track vertices with enough reconstructable charged activity.
cuts.analysis_rationale: Reduces low-multiplicity backgrounds and defines an input axis of the vertex response map.

es.name: Masa del DV mayor que 10 GeV
es.physical_meaning: Conserva vértices de masa alta construidos con las hijas cargadas seleccionadas.
es.analysis_rationale: Suprime fondos de baja masa y proporciona el eje de masa del mapa de respuesta del vértice.

cuts.name: DV mass above 10 GeV
cuts.mathematical_definition: m_DV(selected tracks, charged-pion mass hypothesis) > 10 GeV
cuts.physical_meaning: Keeps high-mass vertices built from the selected charged daughters.
cuts.analysis_rationale: Suppresses low-mass backgrounds and supplies the mass axis of the vertex response map.

es.name: Aceptancia × eficiencia
es.physical_meaning: Pondera los eventos de verdad aceptados con los mapas parametrizados de respuesta de evento y vértice de ATLAS.
es.analysis_rationale: Convierte la aceptancia a nivel de verdad en el rendimiento con respuesta parametrizada del recast.

cuts.name: Acceptance × efficiency
cuts.physical_meaning: Weights fully accepted truth events by digitized ATLAS event and vertex response maps.
cuts.analysis_rationale: Converts truth-level acceptance into the recast's parameterized detector-response yield.

jet_logic.rank_indexing: j4 is jets[3]; jets are sorted by smeared pT descending
jet_logic.missing_jet_semantics: A rank that does not exist makes its branch false.
jet_logic.combination: j4 OR j5 OR j6 OR j7
jet_logic.event_level_note: Branch pass fractions and distributions are unavailable because the original reference execution serialized aggregate cutflow only.
